items.title: Two open immersions of finite type separated schemes over a common open can be made part of one separated finite type scheme by admissible blowups
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated S with open immersions U -> X_1 and U -> X_2 of schemes of finite type and separated over S, the lemma asserts the existence of a commutative diagram whose arrows X_i' -> X_i are U-admissible blowups, whose arrows X_i' -> X are open immersions, and whose X is separated and of finite type over S (statement lines 9646-9661). The proof works throughout with separated finite type schemes, so that the scheme theoretic image of an immersion is a closed subscheme containing the source as a dense open, and starts from X_12, the scheme theoretic image of U in X_1 x_S X_2, whose projections induce isomorphisms over U by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-of-partial-section (proof lines 9663-9680). It chooses U-admissible blowups X_i^i -> X_i making the strict transform X_12^i an open subscheme of X_i^i via Lemma labelled lemma-zariski-after-blowup with ideal I_i, observes that X_12^i -> X_12 is the blowup in p_i^{-1}I_i O_{X_12} by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform, blows X_12 up in the product of the two pulled back ideals so that both transforms appear in one commutative square, and extends the resulting blowup to X_i^i using Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-extend-admissible-blowups (proof lines 9682-9708). The key point is that X'_12 -> X_1' x_S X_2' is an immersion which is proper, hence a closed immersion by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-image-proper-scheme-closed, so glueing X_1' and X_2' along the common open X'_12 produces a scheme X which is finite type and separated over S by Lemma labelled lemma-check-separated; compositions of U-admissible blowups are again U-admissible by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-composition-admissible-blowups (proof lines 9710-9725). Producing one blowup of X_12 dominating both strict transforms and then gluing along it is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
